title: Secrets of Strixhaven Mystical Archive: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Like my creator, I sought perfection. And just as he did, I found only sorrow." —*End of Argentum: The Memoirs of Karn, Scion of Urza*
"Kindness is a war of its own, and one that must never be lost." —*The War-Healer's Treatise*
A root is best pulled by many paws. —Rabbitfolk proverb
"Some claim the archaics can die only after Arcavios's demise. Others claim their deaths herald the plane's doom. The truth? Only time will tell." —Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios
"Against cinder and maw, Against the dread Wildsear, With bright sword in paw, Repel your own fear." —*Song of the Seasons,* stanza 24
"It is our responsibility, as citizens of this world, to reach out with compassion to those who are suffering." —Margeau, Silverquill dean
"It was not rage that made them fight, but honor." —Augusta, Lorehold dean
"It was so embarrassing. Dean Veyran called on me and I just froze. My mind went blank." —Overheard in the Archive stacks
"When you see what nature is capable of, do not believe you'll be the one to withstand its force." —*The Stormwright Texts*
"Let their screams of frustration be your victory song." —*Tome of Obstructions*
"Do not overlook the unusual, for therein often lie the keys to the unknown." —Alquist Proft's case journal
"The clever mage knows that it does not take strength to overcome the enemy, but creativity and intelligence." —*Forces of Negation: A Study in Countermagic*
"We sing of the night the sky fell and the hero who held the vault of heaven aloft." —*Legend of the Nomad Sage*
"We must be prepared to part with things we hold dear to protect those we love." —*A Song of Wartime*
"We see here a perfect example of a fundamental principle. Nothing can be 'destroyed.' It is merely catastrophically reorganized." —Professor Ruxа
"Raw power wins battles, but those who choose the shape of the battlefield win the war." —*The Pool of Knowledge*, opening inscription
"Confounding an enemy can be as effective as disarming them." —*The Trickster's Guide to Staying Alive*
"One does not need to be stronger than their opponent. You need only force them to play their hand before you've shown your own." —*Forces of Negation: A Study in Countermagic*
"Knowledge is infinite, but life is not. Use your time wisely." —*The Biblioplex: An Introduction*
"Some areas are off limits for the preservation of the books. Others for the preservation of the students." —Isabough, Biblioplex archivist
"Ambition can bring you great power or great sorrow, but few prepare for when it brings you both." —*Leadership and Its Consequences*
"Great power awaits those who can stomach its cost." —*The Season of Loss,* chapter one
"Strip away pain, struggle, impurity, fear, flesh. Surrender the pieces and be blessed as one." —*Phyrexian Scriptures*
"You cannot fight the Hunger Tide. You can only run, hide—and pray." —Entry in a tattered journal
"Mortality is a gift. There is a comfort in knowing that the end is coming." —*Vess's Cautions in Necromancy*
"A suit of armor is only as good as its seams." —*Vanity Lost: A Knight's Folly*
"One plane's poison is another's miracle cure. One plane's deadly plague is another's common cold. An interplanar medical body could save an unfathomable number of lives." —Lisette, Witherbloom dean
"I stay away from poems about the night. It's beautiful, yes, but somehow it always feels just a little bit hungry." —Abigale
"The only true immortality comes in the passage of knowledge. Mold one mind and you can live in thousands more." —*The Sanguine Influence*
"Calling the dead isn't difficult. Commanding them once they answer, however, is a different story." —Professor Vess
"We learn so much from the relics we find. What might we have learned from the relics we lost?" —Kirol
"Two strong wills, one wake of destruction." —*The Antiquities War*
"My teeth to bite and break, my claws to rip and rend, my heart with fury quakes, to madness I ascend." —*Kathorran War Chants, vol. 1*
"May the storm yield only when your last enemy has fallen." —*Otarian Battle Cries*
"Lift up the very land and unleash its fury upon your enemies." —*Secrets of the Feradorn Sorcerers*
"When engaging goblins in combat, assume that the number underground is at least double that of those you can see." —*Terrain Tactics and Environmental Magics*
"Even in death, her legend burns bright." —Quintorius Kand
"There is no limit to the ways that anger can twist and break us." —*Revenge and Its Manifestations*
"Alone, we are but the heat, the air, and the kindling. Together, we are the ever-spreading flame." —*The Sisters of Flame*
"There is one beast that makes even titans quail and quake in fear. We shall not name it here, for to name it is to call it." —*A History of Ruinations*
"We woke the forest against the Phyrexian threat, and it's refused to go back to sleep." —Willowdusk
"Life comes at a cost, but steward it well and you will be repaid manyfold." —Lisette, Witherbloom dean
"If you make a mistake when calculating your spell's output, please use the emergency spelltrap nets." —Posting inside Quandrix spell labs
"In the acorn, find the oak; in the cub, find the pride-king. In all living things, great or small, find not what they are, but what they can become." —*The Nature of Infinity, vol. 1*
"Who do you think would win in a fight: a lion or a unicorn?" —Sanar, to Kirol
"The beasts she commanded let loose a deafening roar that presaged the silence of death." —*Multiversal Metahistories*
"Awed by the strength of their love, the Dawn Prince bound them together for eternity, and around them a great forest grew." —*Tales of the Fae*
"Some deaths you can evade. Others are inevitable." —*Compendium of Warspells*
"We are all repurposed in one way or another, and none of us have much say in the matter." —Yedora, grave gardener
"Any student of history has the power to learn from the past. The great ones use it to their advantage." —Plargg, Lorehold dean
"Every piece you create is the result of a thousand choices. Follow your heart, and you cannot choose wrong." —Nassari, Prismari dean
"Destroy what makes your enemy powerful, and you will shatter their will." —Embrose, Silverquill dean
